s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive neurological decline with motor and speech impairment
salient_findings: Episodes of spasms and tremors in the right hand and forearm
Extensive nonenhancing lesions in the bilateral cerebral hemispheres on MRI
key_facts: Woman in her mid-60s
Initial presentation with episodes of spasms and tremors in the right hand and forearm
Underwent carpal tunnel release surgery
Tremors recurred 7 months later
Developed progressive right-sided weakness over 3 months
Dysarthria and slurred speech developed over 3 months
Gait instability developed over 3 months
Brain MRI showed hyperintensities throughout the bilateral cerebral hemispheric white matter, corpus callosum, basal ganglia, thalami, midbrain, upper pons, and middle cerebellar peduncles
T1-weighted fluid-attenuated inversion recovery MRI with contrast showed absence of contrast enhancement
Brain biopsy showed CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ EBV/EBER− cells
Cerebrospinal fluid presence of lymphoma cells
Bone marrow was negative for lymphoma cells
